title: AdaWidth: Query-Adaptive Embedding Width for Dense Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.23862v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: High-dimensional embeddings are central to dense retrieval, but not all of these dimensions need to be evaluated at retrieval time. Existing methods reduce dimensions in two ways: truncating the same leading dimensions for every query, or masking a different subset for each query while still storing and accessing the full embedding. Yet queries within a single task differ widely in the number of dimensions they need for their rankings to stabilize.   We introduce AdaWidth, which adapts the number of evaluated dimensions to each query within a shared prefix representation. An orthogonal prefix adapter applies a single learned rotation to queries and documents alike, concentrating discriminative signal in leading coordinates while leaving every full width inner product unchanged. A lightweight router then reads order statistics off the ranking a query has already produced, and evaluates more dimensions only for the queries whose top result

translated_title: AdaWidth：面向稠密检索的查询自适应嵌入宽度
translated_abstract: 高维嵌入是稠密检索的核心，但并非所有维度都需要在检索时进行评估。现有方法通过两种方式减少维度：对每个查询截断相同的前导维度，或为每个查询掩码不同的子集，但仍需存储和访问完整嵌入。然而，单一任务中的查询在需要多少维度才能使其排序稳定方面差异很大。我们引入了AdaWidth，它根据共享前缀表示中的每个查询自适应调整评估的维度数量。一个正交前缀适配器对查询和文档应用单一学习到的旋转，将判别性信号集中在前导坐标中，同时保持所有完整宽度的内积不变。一个轻量级路由器随后从查询已产生的排序中读取顺序统计量，仅对排名结果不稳定的查询评估更多维度。
tldr: 本文提出AdaWidth方法，通过正交前缀适配器和轻量级路由器，根据每个查询的排序稳定性自适应调整嵌入维度评估数量，在保持完整内积不变的同时提升检索效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AdaWidth, which adapts the number of evaluated embedding dimensions per query via an orthogonal prefix adapter and a lightweight router, preserving full inner products while improving retrieval efficiency.
